encounters.mod.name: Encounters
yacl3.config.encounters:config.mobsDropE: When enabled, mobs spawned by any encounter event can drop the weapons and armor they spawned with. When disabled (default), their equipment is always kept.
yacl3.config.encounters:config.lightning: Master toggle for the lightning overcharge event. When disabled, natural thunderstorm lightning behaves normally.
Probability that any given natural thunderstorm lightning bolt triggers the event. 0 = never, 1 = every bolt.
Minimum number of mobs spawned when the event triggers.
Maximum number of mobs spawned when the event triggers.
When enabled, the first mob of a spawned group acts as leader. The others regroup around it whenever they stray too far, so the encounter stays together. Followers already in combat are left alone.
Distance in blocks beyond which a follower is pulled back toward its leader.
Weighted pool of mobs that may spawn during the event. Click an entry to edit its id, weight, label and SNBT.
yacl3.config.encounters:config.netherPor: Enabled
Master toggle for the nether portal invasion event. When disabled, no portal will ever trigger an invasion.
Scan Interval (ticks)
How often the mod scans loaded chunks looking for active nether portals. 100 ticks = 5 seconds. Lower values are more reactive but slightly more expensive.
Portal Cooldown (ticks)
Minimum time between two invasions triggered by the same portal. 12000 ticks = 10 minutes.
Trigger Chance
Probability that any eligible portal triggers an invasion on a given scan. 0 = never, 1 = every scan.
Waves (min)
Minimum number of waves per invasion.
Waves (max)
Maximum number of waves per invasion.
First Wave Size
Number of mobs in the first wave.
Wave Size Step
Linear scaling: each wave has 'first wave size + (wave-1) * step' mobs.
Wave Cohesion

When enabled, the first mob of each wave acts as leader. Other wave members regroup around it whenever they stray too far. Followers in active combat are left alone, and mounted passengers are skipped.
Cohesion Radius
Distance in blocks beyond which a wave member is pulled back toward its leader.
Mob Pool
Weighted pool of mobs that may spawn from the portal during an invasion. Click an entry to edit its id, weight, label and SNBT.
encounters.config.editMob.title: Edit Mob Entry
encounters.config.editMob.id.desc: Namespaced entity id, e.g. minecraft:zombie or modid:custom_entity.
encounters.config.editMob.weight.desc: Relative weight in the pool. Higher = more frequent.
encounters.config.editMob.label: Label
encounters.config.editMob.label.desc: Optional display name shown in the GUI list and event logs. Leave empty to show only the id.
encounters.config.editMob.nbt.desc: Optional SNBT string applied at spawn, identical to the /summon syntax. Leave empty for default mob behaviour.
